transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Nice to meet you too. Well, I came in today because... I just can't seem to shake this feeling I've been having. Even on my better days, I feel like some people at my church, and in my walking club, are watching me. 

It feels like they're putting little messages about me in the church bulletin, or hiding things about me in what they say to each other. It's just very unsettling, and I figured I should talk to someone about it.
How long have you felt that people at your church or walking club are watching you or sending you hidden messages?

Well, let's see... it's been about eleven months now. That's how long the messages have been going on. And, honestly, it's not just the messages. Hearing voices and just having trouble keeping my thoughts straight... all of that has been happening for about eleven months.
Have the voices and messages continued during times when you felt neither unusually depressed nor unusually energized?

Yes, they have. Um, there was a spell of several weeks where I was actually doing pretty well. I was getting dressed, eating a bit better, and just... not feeling so weighed down. But even during that time, I still heard my name in the house. And I still thought people at church were hinting about me. So, yes, it kept happening even when my mood was better.
During these eleven months, was there a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes, definitely. Actually, that deep sadness... and just feeling guilty all the time, and not caring about anything I used to enjoy... that's been going on for even longer. It's been with me for about a year and two months now, most of the day, almost every day. So it was happening before the messages and the voices even started.
Have you ever had a distinct period when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable compared with your usual mood?

No, I haven't. I don't think I've ever had a time where I felt unusually... elevated or overly energetic. It's really just been the sadness and feeling down. I haven't noticed any periods of being irritable or anything like that, either.

final_diagnosis.reason: Persistent persecutory and referential delusions, auditory hallucinations, and disorganized thinking have been present for approximately 11 months, including during a period without prominent mood symptoms. A major depressive episode has also been present for approximately 14 months, with depressed mood, guilt, and anhedonia. No history of mania or hypomania was reported, supporting schizoaffective disorder, depressive type.
